name: Volcaldera Witch Project
source:
With a new mystery circulating the internet will the group be able to get the footage necessary to pass their class through their documentary on the witch in the Volcaldera woods?

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3357867092]Steam Workshop[/url]]

Made for Snoot Jam 3.
translation:
随着一个新的谜团在互联网上流传，该小组能否获得通过他们关于沃尔卡尔德拉森林女巫的纪录片所需的镜头？

[来自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3357867092]Steam创意工坊[/url]]

专为Snoot Jam 3制作。
